reviews.review:
[h1]Experienced on the Meta Quest 3[/h1]

[u]This is a neutral recommendation.[/u] Honestly, I should probably give this game a negative recommendation based on my experience during my almost 2 hours of playtime. I experienced 4 different game-breaking bugs that I had to get around, usually by restarting the game and losing progress. I should probably refund.

The game is beautiful though. It is one of the most beautiful games in PCVR and really represents what should be the current state of PCVR, visually-speaking. This is not another Quest-ified experience. We should expect visuals like this in every newly released Steam VR game. The game may be worth supporting in Early Access just because of the parts of the game that are excellent. There's many objects you can pick up and interact with. It looks near-realistic. 

The 4 bugs I encountered were frustrating. First bug, the folder you need to drop in the old camera fell to the ground and disappeared. I had to restart the game. Second bug, my left hand got stuck in the blue safe. I had to restart. Third bug, my load game, loaded me into the save file, but without the key the old man who owns the bar gives you. I could not progress. I had to restart the game from the very beginning. Finally, the 4th bug was me falling through the map in the forest. 

That's when I decided to give up. I know this is Early Access, but for me at least, the game was in an unplayable state. Which is a shame, because I want to support development. This is the kind of game PCVR needs. However, the only reason to buy this game is to support development. What's there, after the 2023 prologue, is really kind of sad. You would expect a full game by now, not whatever this is. I guess this is the re-released prologue, only buggier now. Doesn't make sense to me. Is there any new content here to justify this EA release?

[b]Rate 5/10. I only paid $13.50 USD, so it's a gamble and likely a losing investment. I won't refund the game. Hopefully, it pays off. I hope the devs are able to fix the game and expand the content to make it the game we all want in PCVR. However, if I'm being honest, this is a very disappointing start to EA.[/b]

[quote]I bought this game! If you enjoyed my review, please consider joining my Steam Curator group [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/Oculus_WMR]Oculus Rift Reviews.[/url][/quote]
